groups.description: NASA's latest Artemis III candidate landing regions (9, down-selected from the 13 of Aug 2022)
groups.source: NASA news release 'NASA Provides Update on Artemis III Moon Landing Regions', 28 Oct 2024; T. George, M. A. Rubio, S. J. Lawrence, P. Curell, 'Artemis III site selection update: down-selection from 13 to 9 candidate regions', 57th LPSC (2026), abstract 1901, https://www.hou.usra.edu/meetings/lpsc2026/pdf/1901.pdf
groups.coordinates_status: NASA publishes these regions as a labelled map only (LPSC 2026 abstract 1901 Image 1; NASA SVS 5013 has no coordinates or shapefiles). No region-centre coordinates are invented here. All nine lie poleward of 84 S (the Artemis exploration zone, >84 S), so the 1-degree south grid below brackets them until NASA region polygons are obtained.
